title: Vercel static deployment expected the wrong output directory
summary: Numeria Studio's build command produced `dist/`, but Vercel expected `public`, causing deployment failure after a successful local build step. Static Vercel apps should explicitly set `vercel.json#outputDirectory` when the build artifact directory differs from the project default or Vercel project setting.
exceptions: Not applicable when the framework adapter determines output automatically
Not applicable when Vercel project settings already match the generated output directory
